changelog:
- Initial release of the headsman-skill integration package for Herdsman model engine.
- Provides unified access for agent platforms to use Herdsman via OpenAI, Anthropic (messages), and AGUI-compatible endpoints.
- Includes Python scripts for text, image, OCR, embedding, and speech capabilities, following best practices for reliability.
- Adds detailed protocol usage rules, timeout recommendations, and a model discovery requirement for robust integration.
- Advanced speech extension scripts support audio conversion, standalone ASR transcription, and TTS voice cloning workflows.
- Comprehensive documentation and examples included to facilitate platform integration and error handling.
